走马观花地看了几个展厅，我觉得我拍到的这些“游戏元素”顶多是WF里游戏元素的1/5，一定是漏得比拍到得多。WF一共有5个展馆，浮光掠影地走下来也要5个小时，要是排队买点什么那就没数儿了。就在WF展举办的同期，小红书举办的RedLand也在上海举办，一样是个逛足2天每天累断腿的活动。我高中大学的时候，简直想都不敢想有这么密集丰满的文化生活，简直盛世。一方面，现代人的文化娱乐生活真是非常丰富，但另一方面，在WF的人群中，看着拎着好几个盒子，满脸喜悦的参观者们，总让人有所感慨，以前人的情感对象往往只能是另一个人，现在这份情感则被游戏、玩具、手办、网文和偶像什么的东西细细切成了许多快，每个行业各自分到一部分，催生出如此之大的产业规模，哪儿还能有多少留给真人呢？

title: How Bill Skarsgard Became The Face Of Hideo Kojima’s Physint
author: Darryn Bonthuys
text:
Hideo Kojima's spiritual successor to Metal Gear Solid, Physint , doesn't just have a new home at Xbox ; it also has a famous face attached to it, with Bill Skarsgard (It, Boy Kills World) playing the lead role. Thanks to Death Stranding 2: On the Beach composer Yoann "Woodkid" Lemoine, Kojima was introduced to Skarsgard, who would later be cast as the yet-to-be-named protagonist of Physint.
"He's been in some excellent films. Directors I know have worked with him and can't praise him enough," Kojima said on a new episode of the Koji 10 radio program. "I wanted to work with him for a long time. Then one day, Bill visited Woodkid's studio. When Bill went to his studio, he saw piles of Kojima Productions merchandise. He said, 'What's this? Why do you have all this!?' Yoann said, 'I worked with them,' and that’s how Yoann introduced us."
Kojima would later travel to Sweden to meet Skarsgard and his family. Skarsgard was a fan of the Metal Gear franchise, and Kojima pitched him the lead role in Physint, which Skarsgard accepted.
https://youtu.be/YDTq8SeY9s0
It's still early days for Physint, and Kojima says that Skarsgard is eager to get his hands on the game's script so that he can start preparing for the role. "We've finished his scan now. We have to scan actors early, because processing the data takes a long time," Kojima explained. "We'll film the performance much later. But he's so eager he doesn't want to wait. He keeps asking me for the script. I have the plot ready. But he wants to know the lines and how his character speaks. He wants to start preparing now. He's really eager. That's how deeply he gets into a role.
One other crucial factor in choosing Skarsgard was his chemistry with his fellow Physint actor, Charlee Fraser. "The poster we released the other day showed him with Charlee. Their chemistry is very important," Kojima added. "We tested their on-screen chemistry and did a camera test. We scanned them in full makeup. Their clothes were just for reference; these aren't the final costumes. The contrast between these two is striking."
Skarsgard also kept his involvement secret, as Kojima added that not even his parents knew he was going to be the star of Physint. "He's so serious; he hadn’t told anyone. It was confidential, of course, since we hadn't announced it," Kojima added. "Even his parents didn't know. That's impressive. He's a very conscientious person."
Physint won't be out for a long time, but Kojima has said that it's the "biggest-selling" game that he could possibly create . With Skarsgard and several other actors attached, it's likely also a very expensive game to produce, with unconfirmed reports that Physint’s budget at Sony was over $400 million. This figure has never been confirmed, but it is rumored that Xbox is paying a lot less to get it over the finish line.

title: How Is A Game Like GTA 6 Actually Made? Here’s How Rockstar Gets It Done
author: Eddie Makuch
text:
Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 is one of the most highly anticipated game releases this year, or ever. The franchise is known for its massive scope and impressive attention to detail, but how is a game like GTA 6 actually made? In a new interview with Love magazine ( via Kotaku ), Rockstar North boss Rob Nelson said that part of the secret sauce with the GTA franchise is that many of its developers have been working together for a long time and have a "good sense of what they need to do."
In terms of actually building the game, Nelson said the process begins by creating assets and systems, and then "roughing in content across all areas of development."
More specifically, Nelson said GTA 6 was built through a series of eight-week milestones where select pieces of the game are compiled together. Then, the team evaluates those pieces, incorporates changes based on feedback, and then gets back to work on the next milestone.
"We work our way there, year after year, one obsessive day at a time, course-correcting as we go; always with the feeling we want the finished game to have firmly in mind, knowing that often we have to find that feeling, and trusting that, even if we haven’t found it yet, we will eventually," he said.
Another way Rockstar gets a game like GTA 6 out the door is by working with a lot of people. Anyone who watched the credits roll on Rockstar's last game, Red Dead Redemption II, is aware of just how many people worked on that game. For GTA 6, it wouldn't be surprising if the headcount is even higher.
GTA 6 writing director James Horton said, "There are no shortcuts when it comes to building a world like this."
“It’s a question of giving the right people the resources they need to build something that’s not only vast and varied as a whole, but where every part rings true no matter how small it is, or how closely you look at it," he said. "It needs to wash over you when you’re sprinting down the busiest street in the city, hearing snatches of a hundred different conversations as you go; and it needs to be totally convincing if you decide to stop and pay close attention to any one of those conversations."
Rockstar spun up a team in Los Angeles to work exclusively on NPCs, to help them feel more alive.
"Every room in the game, somebody thought about this," Rockstar's Aaron Garbut told The New York Times . "Who's sitting where, what they're drinking, the marks that are left on the table. The pictures on the wall will have the people that are in that room, with their tattoos on their arms and their family behind them. That whole thing has been made, and built, and photographed, and placed in this random room in a random building in a huge city, in a world."
Rockstar's developers also visited strip clubs in Florida and did ride-alongs with police to help get the details right in its recreation of Miami for Vice City.
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. After a long period of silence, Rockstar has finally begun to reveal more details and show the game off. For lots more, be sure to read all of the new things we just learned about GTA 6 .

title: Hideo Kojima Is Keeping OD A Mystery To Make Its Horror Hit Harder
author: Darryn Bonthuys
text:
Games developed by Hideo Kojima typically have an air of mystery, but for his upcoming horror project OD , the veteran game director wants to both terrify and mystify his fans. On a new episode of his weekly radio show Koji10, Kojima briefly spoke about the game, avoiding the release of teasers, and ensuring that players get a proper shock when playing it
"It's still a mystery. That doesn't mean we haven't made the game," Kojima said. "I want to keep quiet and release it. That's unusual for me, isn't it? I normally put out teaser after teaser. This time I don't want to reveal much. A mystery. It's so new that it's a mystery. It aims to create a new experience and test the limits of what players can bear in terms of fear. The limits of fear, that's the idea behind the title. The critical point of fear."
https://youtu.be/YDTq8SeY9s0
OD was originally announced in 2023 , with the game being described as an experiment on what it means to overdose on fear--hence the title, OD. As for Kojima's comments about marketing, the first Death Stranding was a prime example: There were several teaser trailers and extended gameplay previews, each leaving viewers with more questions than answers. Kojima isn't even sure OD will find an audience , as he believes the gameplay systems are unlike anything he's created in his career.
Alongside his Metal Gear Solid spiritual successor Physint , Xbox is supporting development on OD, and the game is reportedly safe from the studio closures, layoffs, and game cancellations that have hit Microsoft's gaming division throughout 2026.
The game features actors Hunter Schafer and Sophia Lillis, although it's unclear how much of a role the late Udo Kier will have in OD, following his death last year . Kojima previously said that the 2025 SAG-AFTRA strike forced the team to reschedule filming for OD until 2026, although Kier can still be seen in the early teaser for OD.

title: Why GTA Studio Co-Founder Is Avoiding GTA 6–And All Open-World Games
author: Eddie Makuch
text:
Rockstar co-founder Dan Houser left the company in 2020 and now runs a new outfit called Absurd Ventures. Houser will be forever connected to the GTA franchise, and he's now weighed in on GTA 6 .
He told Variety that he did not watch the "Extended Look" trailer and doesn't plan to. Why? He said he tries to avoid consuming things that are going to "disrupt me creatively."
"And given that I spend a large amount of time trying to make open-world games, and the rest of my conscious time trying to figure out innovative ways to market them, I don’t need to see what other people are [doing]," he said. "I’m always trying to think about new ways of doing it, not sit there in some kind of comparison of what I would have done differently.”
Also in the interview, Houser said he doesn't play a lot of open-world games anymore, for similar reasons.
"I find when I play them, I can almost deconstruct the strengths and weaknesses of the team in real time and it’s distracting. I’m always thinking, ‘Well, their animation team is weak, but I think this game design is fantastic.’ And, ‘Oh, I can imagine that meeting when they discuss this feature,'" he said. "I’m not a game designer; I’m a sort of creative director. So I’m trying to always find new things that haven’t been done before, or that I can steal from older media, quite frankly or just inspired me or things I always thought about.”
Jasona and Lucia in GTA 6.
It's not that Absurd Ventures is burying its head in the sand, however. Houser went on to say he has a team of people at his company who take the time to examine "what everyone else is doing."
He said when Rockstar began to develop Red Dead Redemption, he avoided watching any more Western films. For GTA, he said he avoided HBO's acclaimed mob show The Sopranos (1999-2007) because "it would have disrupted everything I did on GTA" if he had seen the show while formulating the GTA series, which was first released in 1997.
"So I really try and avoid things that I think are going to overly influence me," he said.
Houser is now working on multiple projects at Absurd Ventures, including an open-world comedy game that he will reveal further "in the next few months." Another is a dystopian sci-fi game about "video game development gone very wrong" when a rogue AI becomes sentient.
He said in the Variety interview that "there could be no greater compliment" than to be forever associated with GTA. At the same time, Houser said he hopes some of what he works on at Absurd Venture can be successful in its own right.
Dan Houser's brother and Rockstar co-founder, Sam Houser, remains at Rockstar and was involved in the creation of GTA 6. GQ writer Sam White recently posted a series of tweets (and then deleted them) saying an interview he had planned with Sam Houser fell apart at the last minute . That's notable because Sam Houser rarely gives any interviews at all, nor does he appear in Rockstar's official promotional efforts for the company's releases.
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. In other news, Rockstar recently revealed some of its secrets and detailed how a game like GTA 6 gets made .

title: New Gears Of War: E-Day Patch Addresses Giant Vomiting Frog Error Codes
author: Darryn Bonthuys
text:
Gears of War: E-Day rolls out worldwide starting October 6, and thanks to early access players, The Coalition has identified several issues that it's fixing with the game's first patch. Focused mostly on overall stability and performance across the game's campaign, multiplayer, and Horde Siege modes, the Gears of War: E-Day update is out now.
One of the biggest fixes is the "Bilefrog-Kalona" error, an issue named after the gigantic subterranean Locust frogs encountered throughout the game, which regularly try to kill you by vomiting stomach acid at your position. Nasty stuff. The Coalition assigned several Gears-themed names to its network errors, and in this case, getting vomit-frogged is a specific split-screen multiplayer issue. This triggers when a split-screen player is automatically signed out of online services after the console or PC is suspended, then tries to use Quick Resume to hop back in.
The Coalition says it has also addressed an issue in Versus Social matches that results in players entering a waiting-lobby limbo, and fixed an issue that could prevent certain Siege Blitz Secure objectives from being completed. For the campaign, several pesky problems across Act 2 are being patched, while other game-wide instances of sticky turrets and unearned War Journal progress have been resolved.
These fixes come on the eve of the game's worldwide rollout on PC and Xbox Series X|S, and an influx of Game Pass subscribers are expected to enter Kalona starting tomorrow. While the overall story isn't the best Gears of War narrative, the game is still recommended for anyone who wants a big, dumb, and loud cover-based shooter that looks gorgeous on PC and Xbox Series X|S.
"For better or worse, E-Day is distinctly Gears, and I had a good time with it, even if the story is disappointing and the open areas are fairly dull," Richard Wakeling wrote in GameSpot's Gears of War: E-Day campaign review . "But that’s all it is: a good game, propped up by combat that hasn’t changed all that much over the past 20 years. That’s enough to skate by, but I wish Gears of War would dig deeper."
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=teClq4qYyzQ
Gears of War: E-Day October 5 Patch Notes
Stability and Performance
Made various stability, performance, hardware compatibility, and reporting improvements across the game
Online and multiplayer services
Addressed an issue causing some Versus Social matches to remain on the “Waiting for players” screen
Improved Xbox authentication handling when the system clock differs significantly from the correct time
Addressed "Bilefrog-Kalona" error, where a split-screen player could be signed out after suspending and resuming the game
Improved online-session stability when accessing session information
Campaign
Addressed an issue where players joining an existing Campaign could receive War Journal progress and Forge rewards earned before they joined
Addressed an issue where players could remain attached to turrets when a cinematic or gameplay moment began
Addressed an issue where some join-in-progress players might not receive the expected Forge Discovery War Journal progress
Act 2 Chapter 2: Addressed an issue where the objective could fail to update when entering Allfather’s Plaza after completing activities elsewhere in the mission
Act 2 Chapter 2: Addressed an issue where the Heavy Gear in the Black Raven Down side objective could appear without a Vulcan
Act 4 Chapter 1: Addressed an issue where certain side objectives could fail to start if players entered the objective area while introductory dialogue was playing
Act 4 Chapter 2: Addressed one cause of the Power Station defense objective failing to complete after all visible enemies were defeated
Horde Siege
Addressed an issue that could prevent certain Siege Blitz Secure objectives from being completed
Addressed an issue where the extraction helicopter could fail to appear during a Downtown West Blitz mission
Versus
Addressed an issue in Demolition where a bomb could become stuck in a defusing state if a player was eliminated while beginning the defuse interaction
UI
Adjusted the size and appearance of Online Diagnostic text
Addressed one possible cause of the UI repeatedly attempting to claim the same Challenge Mail reward

title: Amid Uncharted 5 Rumors, Nathan Drake Actor Says He Would Come Back, But With One Catch
author: Eddie Makuch
text:
One of actor Nolan North's most famous roles is that of Nathan Drake in Naughty Dog's Uncharted franchise, but he wrapped things up with 2016's Uncharted 4: A Thief's End. There are rumors that Naughty Dog is making a new Uncharted game , and North has said he would "110%" be up for coming back in a new game in the storied series.
“110%. Absolutely. I think it would be one of the biggest games ever if they decided to do it. It just depends if Sony wants to make money," he said at Gamergy in Puerto Rico prior to the recent rumors of Uncharted 5 ( via DomTheBomb ). "I absolutely would. I try to stay in shape just in case. I can't see a scenario where I would say no. I always keep out hope."
Nolan North in the Uncharted movie.
North went on to clarify that he has not heard anything about a new Uncharted game where he might be asked to come back, but he thinks it would be a good business decision for Sony.
"It is a business-my god, can you imagine if they did? It would be the biggest announcement in gaming. I don't think that's hyperbole. I think that's true," he said.
North said he enjoyed working with Naughty Dog over the years on the four main Uncharted games, and that's part of why he would be up to come back.
His one caveat, however, is that he hopes Naughty Dog wouldn't make something that doesn't live up to the franchise's legacy. He cited Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull as an example of a middling movie in an otherwise great series, and he doesn't want that to happen for Uncharted.
According to multiple sources, a fifth mainline Uncharted game will be Naughty Dog's next project after Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet , which is reportedly due for release in 2027. A third The Last of Us game could follow after.
Intriguingly, the report said Nathan Drake would appear in the hypothetical Uncharted 5 in some capacity. Uncharted 4 was positioned as the definitive end for Nathan Drake’s story when it released in 2016, but Naughty Dog has repeatedly suggested that it is not done with the franchise .
When Uncharted 5 might release is anyone’s guess, but it’s more likely that it’ll arrive on the PlayStation 6 given that Sony is expected to release its next-generation console sometime in 2028.
North played Nathan Drake in the four main Uncharted games, but not The Lost Legacy. He had a cameo in the Uncharted movie, too.

title: Halloween’s First DLC Reveals Even The Bad Sequels Will Get Some Love
author: Mark Delaney
text:
Halloween's first paid DLC is coming on October 27 in the form of a new skin for the game's killer, Michael Myers, and it's pulling from a source you might not expect: Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers. A free update on the same day will also add a fifth map, The Tower Farm, inspired by a location in the same film.
It may seem odd to jump to the fifth movie for the game's first DLC, but it's not the only piece of new content coming that day. There's also a second skin coming for Big Mike, borrowing from his look in the legacy sequel Halloween (2018). Each skin will run you $10.
Survivor mains also have new things to look forward to, including two new characters, Michelle and Eugene, as well as Civilian Costumes Pack 1, which includes 14 outfits--one for each survivor character--and 42 colorings, or "tints." The new survivors will also go for $10, though that's for the pair, not for each of them, while the new styles and colors will be--you guessed it--$10 for the set. This content drop is the first of several coming to the game in its first year, development studio Illfonic said.
With 13 movies in the series, there's still plenty of ground to cover for Halloween, which makes kicking off its post-launch roadmap with Halloween 5 such an interesting choice. The appropriately autumnal farm map is more open than the game's earlier maps, making it harder to break line of sight from Haddonfield's boogeyman. I suppose that moody setting was too picturesque to pass up as an update just days before October 31.
Just days before Halloween, Halloween will look more like, uh, Halloween.
As much as I love the 1978 original, I'm not particularly fond of most of the Halloween sequels, though Halloween H20 is probably dearest to me; I fondly recall seeing it on the big screen as a horror-obsessed nine-year-old, so I look forward to seeing that one reflected in the game down the line.
In any event, I don't think the sequels' quality ought to keep the development team from bringing them into the game like this. Illfonic's game should be a museum to all things Halloween, and watching it become that over the next few years is an exciting prospect. I hope the licensing deal extends to the series' more oddball entries, like Rob Zombie's reboot duology and Halloween 3--the one movie in the series that doesn't involve Michael Myers. If the game follows the roadmap I've built in my mind, we'll see every version of The Shape on the character select screen one day.
In GameSpot's Halloween review , I wrote that it gives players "a vibes-heavy experience befitting the timeless film, while also offering a unique hook that keeps the game from feeling like a rehash of the many horror multiplayer games that came before it."

title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer Is Free To Play Now, If You Know Where To Look
author: Darryn Bonthuys
text:
Star Wars: Galactic Racer is finally out, and so far, it might just be one of the best Star Wars games ever made. The new racing game has an attractive MSRP of $60, but if you're looking to grab it for the low price of nothing , you can play it for free through Amazon Luna starting today.
Amazon has announced that Prime members can stream the single-player campaign for free through Amazon Luna. "We've always believed Luna players deserve to be in the action from day one, and Star Wars: Galactic Racer makes that a reality for the first time,” Jeff Gattis, Head of Gaming at Amazon, said in a blog post. "Luna players can jump into the single-player campaign today without needing to own a console or wait for a lengthy download. It's exactly the kind of experience we want to deliver on Luna, and we think players are going to love it."
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eA3BrR245mo
If you're unfamiliar with it, Amazon Luna is a cloud gaming service and platform available to Prime members. A rotating selection of games appears every month through Luna, and members can also claim several downloadable PC games. These can be redeemed through storefronts like the Epic Games Store and GOG. Last month was particularly good , as members could claim several of id Software's critically acclaimed Doom games, including the 2016 reboot and Doom Eternal.
Set early during the era of the New Republic, Star Wars: Galactic Racer follows players as they take part in the Galactic League, a high-stakes underground racing circuit. What sets the game apart from other racing titles is its roguelike gameplay mechanics, which evolve the standard racing formula into a dynamic experience. Developed by Fuse Games--a studio founded by racing veterans from the Burnout and Need for Speed franchises--Star Wars: Galactic Racer currently has a metascore of 88 on GameSpot sister site Metacritic.
"Galactic Racer is those absolutely perfect 10 minutes expanded into a full game. Every moment feels joyfully fast," Jordan Ramée wrote in GameSpot's Star Wars: Galactic Racer review . "Every decision carries the weight of tension. And every run is a rewarding chance to learn, improve, tinker, and adapt, whether it ends in success or failure. I can’t wait to keep playing what’s been my favorite racing game in years."

title: Steam Frame Gets VR Right Where So Many Others Went Wrong
author: Darryn Bonthuys
text:
The virtual reality market has grown over the years, and depending on your budget, there's probably a VR headset out there for you. But can your VR gaming budget stretch to over $1,000 for the entry-level Steam Frame headset , and is it even worthwhile? That's the question GameSpot's senior video producer Kurt Indovina set out to answer, and after spending some time with it, his main takeaway was that it's the best VR headset he's ever used, and possibly the last one he'll ever own.
https://youtu.be/NcypRmYfP5s
"Having used this solid piece of tech for a couple of weeks now, it's been great to replay things like Half-Life: Alyx or booting up Ghost Town, or fiddling around in Hot Dogs, Horseshoes, and Hand Grenades," Indovina explained. "It's also been a time of reflection for VR as a whole, from where it started, where it went, and where it currently sits now. I've been an advocate for VR for a while. I've made plenty of videos about VR. In fact, the first GameSpot video I ever appeared in was for Five Nights at Freddy's VR."
"But for all of the love I've given VR, my gripes with it seem to be never-ending. I've been very vocal about how companies have stunted the growth of VR and are trying to chokehold the market with their product. Meta putting out the most affordable and accessible headset only to commit, for lack of a better term, public suicide by investing everything into the metaverse, favoring a dystopian weird social life and alienating people who just want to play games."
But if you look at the Steam Frame in a vacuum? "It rules," Indovina said. "I'm sure this thing will get support for a lot of other cool games. It's great."
The Steam Frame isn't the first time that Valve has launched VR hardware, but compared to 2019's Valve Index, this standalone wireless headset is a major leap forward. It offers inside-out tracking, improved streaming support, onboard processing, and Android compatibility, but it is one of the pricier models on the market right now. It's still cheaper than Meta's next foray into virtual reality, as the Facebook parent company recently unveiled its new $1,300 Meta VR Glasses , with a flashy trailer that didn't even mention VR gaming.
But if you've got the cash to flash and you're purely interested in gaming, the Steam Frame is worth considering, if you can get your hands on one, since they've sold out surprisingly fast. If you wear glasses, you'll also want to double-check your frame and avoid making an expensive purchase for high-tech VR gear you can't use.

title: Sega Announces $7,000 Sonic The Hedgehog Pottery, And I Can’t Stop Watching How It’s Made
author: Darryn Bonthuys
text:
Time flies by fast, especially if you're Sega's blue mascot, as 2026 marks the 35th anniversary of Sonic the Hedgehog . While Sega has various plans to commemorate the milestone, one of the most elegant is a hand-painted porcelain sculpture that is both graceful and expensive . Even if you can afford to shell out big bucks for this Blue Blur pottery, you'll still need luck on your side, as only 50 of these pieces are being made.
Sculpted by the artisans of the Japanese studio YOYOYO, this ornate piece costs a whopping $7,000. It comes with a certificate of authenticity, a wooden stand, and a wooden box, but you'll need to enter a lottery to have a chance to buy it.
So what makes this piece so special? To realize the idea of Sonic being the "world's fastest blue," the studio incorporated gosu, a cobalt-blue underglaze pigment that results in a color that never fades. This created an "eternal blue" finish, and the artisans also designed this sculpture to have a shelf-life of at least 100 years.
https://youtu.be/DzCJw-H7Xfo
For the base, durable Amakusa porcelain stone was chosen, as its white surface lets colors shine through, and the artists used techniques like delicate underglaze painting to create Seigaiha and Shippo patterns. This requires incredible skill and concentration to pull off successfully, as the patterns are ornate and hard to keep uniform. This is time-consuming, back-breaking work to do once, let alone 50 times, but the neat thing is that each piece will be unique up close, so you can appreciate the subtle details of the craft.
The red is also special, as it's applied to the partner piece that expresses the an endless infinity trail. According to the artists, glossy red carries motion and heat, and they also change expression with the viewing angle.
Other neat details include the other blue hues chosen for this project, with the Yagasuri shade featuring a stylized arrow-feather pattern to symbolize strong forward motion. You can take a closer look at how this work of Sonic the Hedgehog art was put together in the video above, which features a detailed (and enjoyably soothing) look at the artistry involved.
It might be a major anniversary year for Sonic the Hedgehog, but strangely, there's no game tie-in to mark the occasion. Sonic has had a consistent run of releases throughout the 2020s--with titles like Sonic Colors: Ultimate (2021), Sonic Frontiers (2022), Sonic Superstars (2023), Sonic X Shadow Generations (2024), and Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds (2025)--but it looks like the franchise is taking a break in 2026. While work continues on the next mainline game, Sega is leaning into updates for Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds alongside merchandise and community events to celebrate the decades-spanning career of its icon.

title: Warner Bros. Games Now Belongs To Skydance, But Company Makes No Mention Of That In Big Announcement
author: Eddie Makuch
text:
Paramount has officially completed its $111 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, but the company's announcement of the deal closing did not contain a single mention of video games. That's notable because Warner Bros. Discovery is heavily invested in video games, and many may wonder what's coming next.
CEO David Ellison says he is a big gamer himself , but whether or not that means anything for the future of games at the new company, now known as Skydance, is unknown. Ellison, the son of billionaire Oracle founder Larry Ellison, courted controversy due to his family's dealings with Donald Trump and the current administration, with some industry observers believing the close relationship helped get the deal through the regulatory process.
Netflix originally secured the top bid for WBD and believed its deal would close, but Paramount swooped in with more money and a contract to buy the whole company, not just parts of it like Netflix was planning. For its part, Netflix executives spent time with Trump and his team as well. Co-CEO Ted Sarandos recently praised Trump for believing in and supporting the entertainment industry.
Skydance's press release announcing the closing of the deal hypes up Ellison's stated plans to put a minimum of 30 "high-quality" movies in theaters annually, and touts its "creative-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, and globally scaled" setup, but doesn't mention video games at all.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c2hu5UML3NI
The news release does mention that the combined companies will offer content for people "across every entertainment vertical," and that would seemingly include video games. But the brief does not include any specifics. GameSpot has followed up with Skydance seeking more information.
Speaking to staff, Skydance boss Ynon Kreiz mentioned games specifically. According to The Hollywood Reporter , he said the company will have "plenty of opportunities to develop new businesses, products, games, and experiences to engage fans wherever they are and be where the consumer is going."
For what it's worth, when Netflix was planning to buy WBD, the streaming giant was similarly quiet on its plans for video games, saying it did not factor in video games very much . This came despite how 2023's Hogwarts Legacy was a bonafide juggernaut, selling more than 30 million copies.
While the release doesn't mention video games specifically, it does call out scary and tough times ahead for the people who work there. One of the main bullet points in the release was that Skydance is planning at least $6 billion in "run-rate syngeries within three years," which is likely a forecast for layoffs and cuts. Skydance's official word, however, is that the savings will "primarily" come from "technology, integration and procurement, marketing and real estate rationalization."
When big companies combine, layoffs often happen--it was the case for Microsoft, too, when it bought Activision Blizzard, with the company slashing thousands of jobs.
Skydance recently rolled out Paramount Games Studio, a team that folded in Skydance Interactive and Skydance New Media. Projects in the works at those studios are continuing, including Marvel 1943: Rise of Hyrdra and a new Star Wars game with Lucasfilm from Amy Hennig, now under the Paramount Games Studio banner.
With Skydance now running the show, the company takes ownership of numerous big gaming properties , including Hogwarts Legacy developer Avalanche Software and its publishing label, Portkey Games; Mortal Kombat and its developer, NetherRealm; and Batman: Arkham studio Rocksteady. Skydance is also now in charge of Lego developer TT Games, and numerous other developers, including WB Games Boston, WB Games Montreal, WB Games New York, WB Games San Francisco, and numerous other studios.
Beyond developing games themselves, Skydance is making the Call of Duty movie with Activision , which is due for release in 2028.

With Skydance now running the show, the company takes ownership of numerous big gaming properties, including Hogwarts Legacy developer Avalanche Software and its publishing label, Portkey Games; Mortal Kombat and its developer, NetherRealm; and Batman: Arkham studio Rocksteady. Skydance is also now in charge of Lego developer TT Games, and numerous other developers, including WB Games Boston, WB Games Montreal, WB Games New York, WB Games San Francisco, and numerous other studios.

Beyond developing games themselves, Skydance is making the Call of Duty movie with Activision, which is due for release in 2028.

title: How To Get GTA 6’s $100 Edition For $80 Right Now
author: Eddie Makuch
text:
If you're looking for GTA 6 's $100 Ultimate Edition but don't want to pay that much, there is a way to get it for $80--if you meet a few requirements.
Costco has rolled out a nice new deal where you can get four $25 PlayStation Store gift cards for $80. Or you can buy two $75 gift cards for $120 . These offers are good through October 11 or while supplies last, so act fast.
While Costco does not require people to have a membership ($65/year) to shop online, the deals for these PlayStation gift cards are listed as "members only."
While GTA 6's $80 edition will be sold in stores via a code in a box, GTA 6's $100 edition will seemingly not be sold in stores. This makes the $100 edition even more profitable for Rockstar and Take-Two because digital games have better margins than games sold in stores.
The $100 Ultimate Edition of GTA 6 comes with many digital extras, including special weapon variants, a retro-inspired car, a boat, and special clothing. Additionally, the premium edition is the only way you can get access to a range of in-game stores and locations, including Rideout Customs for updating your car, Sara's Unisex Salon for getting a new haircut, and Electric Fang Tattoo for getting some ink.
These outfits are only for people who pay $100 for GTA 6.
It remains to be seen what will happen for those who buy the $80 edition with regard to these shops. Are the doors of these stores locked? Is there a literal paywall where you have to fork over extra cash to get in? Do they not even appear in the world for $80 players? Rockstar and Take-Two are well-versed in microtransactions, and the game's ESRB rating says these will be in the game , but we don't know yet how it will work in practice.
GTA 6 becomes available to preload beginning November 12, and that applies to the game's digital and physical versions sold at retailers. The game unlocks to play on November 19 across PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

title: Warhammer Survivors Is Launching Mere Days Before GTA 6, And I Respect The Audacity
author: Darryn Bonthuys
text:
The next Survivors-like game--or Survivaton, as Vampire Survivors developer Poncle refers to them--is out soon, and it's threatening to cut into GTA 6 playtime. Warhammer Survivors launches November 10 on PC, consoles, and mobile devices, and you can also grab a new demo on PC via Steam right now.
Set in the grim (and dark) 41st millennium of the Warhammer 40,000 franchise, Warhammer Survivors sticks to the Vampire Survivors playbook : You'll fight all manner of Tyranid enemies that threaten the Imperium of Man, evolve your weapons, and die a lot before you're strong enough to start easily tanking the waves of heretical creatures. Extremis bosses will push your builds to the limit, and when it launches, the game will feature over 40 playable characters and an arsenal of 70 weapons to collect.
https://youtu.be/XvvWBS2uMw8
Warhammer Survivors will release on PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2, and Switch next month, and it'll also be available via Xbox Game Pass. The new demo will give you a fresh taste of the carnage, featuring the heroes Lyssa Revenya and the Legend of Catachan.
It's one of the few November games willing to take a risk and launch close to November 19, as many publishers and developers have opted to avoid the GTA 6-sized elephant in the room . Only a few games are standing their ground, including one that features the king of the monsters , Godzilla.
This isn't the only Survivaton on the way, as Poncle is also working on Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble . Like Vampire Survivors and Warhammer Survivors, it features the same bullet-heaven gameplay, but it draws from the manga and anime series' Culling Games storyline to shift the focus toward a "survivors royal" experience. The goal is to exorcise cursed spirits, grow your power, and outscore your opponents to be the last player standing. Originally scheduled to launch this year, the release date was shifted to 2027.

title: GameStop Is Preparing Us For Next-Gen Pricing With $1,400 Used PS5 Pros
author: Evan Campbell
text:
Sticker shock might be underselling it with GameStop's new used pricing for Sony's most powerful system. Starting today, the video game store is listing pre-owned PS5 Pros for $1,400, though GameStop Pro members only need to dish out $1,330. Basically, it's a $500 surcharge over a brand-new PS5 Pro and capitalizing on the fact that those are stock-constrained currently.
A generous take on GameStop's new strategy for used PS5 Pros is that the company's conditioning us ahead of the possibility that the PS6 could cost $1,000 or more . Obviously, Sony isn't the only one increasing hardware pricing and consoles probably aren't getting cheaper anytime soon --mainly because of the ongoing chip shortage from AI development.
A more cynical take is that GameStop is taking advantage of the situation similar to what scalpers do with the launch of new video game consoles. I'm also curious how many people now trade in a PS5 Pro at GameStop when they see how much the company is then reselling it for. Wouldn't an easier option just be to undercut them on Facebook Marketplace or eBay by $100?
Similar pricing for used PS5 Pro systems can be seen on Amazon and Best Buy's storefronts. One key difference here is that those are third-party sellers, such as this RYTEK example at Best Buy . GameStop is officially behind the pre-owned pricing on its own website.
Sony raised pricing for PS5, PS5 Pro, and PlayStation Portal in April. The PS5 Pro was $750 previously and now retails for $900, if you can find one. When PS5 Pro originally launched in November 2024 , the system cost $700. Meanwhile, the Xbox lineup also saw another round of price hikes in August, with the cheapest option being an Xbox Series S for $500. This is the first generation of video game systems to increase in price dramatically over the years , instead of getting much cheaper.

title: Solo Horror Dev Makes A Creepy Connection To A Real Haunted Island In Mexico
author: Ashley Bardhan
text:
Being a haunted doll must be difficult. You're missing an eyeball, and your lipstick makes you look more like a cannibal than a cherub. People make faces of disgust at you in the antique mall, and you want to tell them you're actually the unblemished soul of a 19th century nun named Eunice, but they speed away before you can. But if you were a haunted doll, you'd at least have solo developer Steelkrill Studio on your side, as its upcoming survival horror game Where Dolls Hang features real-life creepy dolls looking proudly injured.
The dolls of Mexico's Isla de las Muñecas , the Island of the Dolls, have been through a lot over the past 80 years. Folklore suggests the bald dolls cobwebbed and nailed to the island's trees contain the spirit of a drowned little girl, who caretaker Don Julian Santana may or may not have made up. In any case, he spent much of his life fishing plastic Barbies and babies out of the water near his home to honor her spirit. So Where Dolls Hang, which was featured in the Horror Game Awards' recent showcase this past summer, is a tribute, too--it honors the fact that our real world is often freakier than fiction.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KwPGsK7yWA4
"Some of the doll models you'll find were created using real photographs," developer Steelkrill explains on Twitter . "The photographs can also be found around in the game." An accompanying clip of first-person gameplay footage demonstrates with an image of a doll head coated completely in dirt and little pimples from raindrops. The Where Dolls Hang player then drops the photo and stares ahead; the same pimply doll head is sticking from a pike right in front of them.
"It creates an unusual connection between the game's horrors and reality: something disturbing hanging in a room or sitting in the darkness may not have been designed entirely from imagination," a press release says. "Somewhere in the world, there may be a real photograph behind it." Intriguingly, that makes Where Dolls Hang a rare game that is based on a true story, since life is unknowable without art to make sense of it.
Where Dolls Hang is scheduled for a 2026 release date, and it's available to wishlist now on Steam .

title: Call Of Duty’s Richtofen Actor Wants Him To Come Back, Says 2027’s CoD Could Be From Sledgehammer
author: Eddie Makuch
text:
Veteran video game actor Nolan North has addressed his future in the Call of Duty series, saying he hopes to reprise his character Dr. Edward Richtofen from Black Ops' popular Zombies mode.
If this does happen, it probably won't be soon. That's because, North said he believes 2027's Call of Duty game might be developed by Sledgehammer. Given that, a new Black Ops game might not come until 2028 at the soonest, but this is just conjecture.
Speaking at Gamergy in Puerto Rico ( via DomTheBomb ), North said he hopes Richtofen's story continues in a future Black Ops game, whenever that might be.
"I always like when they leave things open for the next one. I know that Infinity Ward and I think Sledgehammer has the next two before there is another Black Ops. I just don't want it to be the end of Richtofen, and I don't think it is," he said.
North clarified that he does not know for sure that Richotfen's story will continue, so he hoped people wouldn't think he had some inside knowledge apart from his own hope and belief. Whatever the case, North said Richotofen is one of his favorite characters to voice, and he hopes to reprise him someday.
North first appeared as Richtofen in 2008's World at War, and has reprised the role many times over in subsequent games from developer Treyarch. He's a fan-favorite character in the fan-favorite Zombies mode, with the story taking numerous twists and turns over the years.
"It's been such a pleasure getting to work with my friends for so long, just like Uncharted was," he said.
On the subject of Uncharted, North said he hopes to come back to play Nathan Drake once more . As it happens, rumors are swirling that Naughty Dog is working on Uncharted 5 and that Drake might have a role in it.
Regarding North's statement that Sledgehammer is working on the 2027 Call of Duty game, that's not confirmed, but doesn't seem outrageous given this has been reported since 2024 . The studio's last game where it served as lead developer was 2023's Modern Warfare 3, so it might be time for Sledgehammer to take the lead again in 2027. Intriguingly, it's also been reported that Activision's new ownership of the Halo franchise could include Sledgehammer, or at least a division inside the developer, working on a Halo game .
This year's Call of Duty game is Modern Warfare 4, and Infinity Ward is leading development. The game releases on October 23 for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2, and PC.

title: IGN《天机行：古朝之影》上手前瞻：以唐代为舞台的 HD-2D 风回合制 RPG
author: Patrick Kolan
text:
失忆男主闯荡手绘 HD-2D 风回合制 RPG
游戏基本信息： 天机行：古朝之影 / Tianji: Shadow of the Ancients / 2027 年 / Nintendo Switch、Nintendo Switch 2、PS5、PC
Square Enix 用近年来的成果证明了 HD-2D 风格有着可观的受众规模，而这种风格也为复古回合制 RPG 注入了新鲜的血液。不过搭上了 HD-2D 这班车的可不光是 JRPG。来自中国台北的开发商杰仕登最近公布了他们倾心打造的 RPG 新作《天机行：古朝之影》。该作同样是一款向经典 RPG 致敬的类 HD-2D 作品，只不过带有浓郁而鲜明的中华风。
《天机行》的舞台并非使用魔法的奇幻世界，而是一个与现实世界相似却又不同、以“气”为能量的唐代。了解东方武侠的玩家肯定对“气”这个概念不陌生，但简而言之，“气”是存在于所有生灵中的能量，难点在于如何驾驭这股能量，从而用它施展出强大而神秘的力量。所以说起来，“气”其实也算是一种魔法，只不过有着不同的根源。
《天机行》的主角名唤上官朔，在剧情一开头，他被可疑组织“玄心教”弄得失去了记忆 —— 这可以说是主角的经典开局了。说真的，这些家伙就应该把头盔焊在头上。总而言之，以这次头部受伤为契机，他踏上了一段寻回记忆的旅途，在此过程中，他还需要搞清楚脑海里那个让他不断怀疑自我身份的神秘声音究竟是什么来头。
在旅途中，我们还会遇到一群乐于加入队伍，愿意在一个又一个回合里为主角挡刀的伙伴们。他们还真是古道热肠。
经典回合制 RPG 爱好者可以在《天机行》中收获不少乐趣 《天机行：古朝之影》将轻度探索与更具深度的回合制战斗机制结合在一起，带来了不错的效果。与 Square Enix 的像素点阵角色不同，《天机行》采用了清晰的 2D Q 版小人，更加贴近他们的正比例立绘形象。
这些 Q 版小人有不少动作细节，在引擎内即时渲染的过场动画里可以呈现出丰富的神态。而其余过场动画，则是采用了水墨画风格与传统 3D 场景相结合的形式。
《天机行》以虚幻引擎 5 打造，整个世界由 3D 的小村庄、城镇、洞窟、森林、山脉组成。镜头始终以固定距离跟随主角，带来了很好的景深效果。
整个游戏的设计配方可能会让你感到熟悉，但开头几小时的内容很容易让人投入其中 —— 即便你平时不喜欢玩回合制 RPG，觉得它们太慢太枯燥。就我个人而言，回合制 RPG 那种有条不紊、步步为营的节奏正是其魅力所在，不过喜好这种事情嘛，各花入各眼。
但为了照顾习惯了快节奏的“多动症”玩家，开发团队也很明智地加入了一些用于提速的现代化功能。比如战斗可以开 2 倍速；在等级达到一定程度后，遇到低等级敌人时可以直接将其秒杀，无需进战。
花些时间解锁新的“气”技能，并用技能针对敌人的属性弱点，绝对是值得的 养成系统也秉承类似的理念：垂直技能树上有着相当丰富的分支，每一次加点都需要仔细斟酌，而不是形式主义、徒增臃肿的加点。技能会在整个队伍内形成联动效果，而不是只影响当前行动的角色。
大部分技能围绕属性克制设计，为战斗增添了一层策略性，避免了无脑按键的枯燥感。例如 Demo 中有一个名叫“乱星飞羽 贰”的技能，它会对随机目标发动三次攻击，若触发暴击，技能还会再生效一次。这足以让人预感到，在流程到了十多个小时后，技能树应该会展现出相当可观的深度。
在旅途中，玩家会结识到新的同伴，每个新队友都有专属的个人支线，以及一个其他人不能解锁的专属技能。多花些时间和一个角色相处，其专属技能就会得到强化，带来武器强化、营地烹饪 Buff、将闲置物品换成实用道具等等效果。
虽然“队友越用越强”是个老套路，但属于百试不爽的经典设计，给玩家提供了使用那些“二线”角色的理由，而不是全程只用最强的那三个角色。
水墨风大地图看上去赏心悦目，为探索体验增色不少，我也很喜欢玩家可以主动触发战斗的设计 在战斗的间隙，大地图上的那些“气脉”（Qi leylines）并非没有实际作用的趣味性背景设定。它们贯穿整个大地图，合理推测，后续它们应该会解释为什么《天机行》那么注重游戏中的景色。若是离开主干道四处探索，你会发现隐藏 Boss、支线任务和隐藏迷宫 —— 任何一款像样的 RPG，都会用这些要素来奖励那些喜欢无视任务标记、到处自由探索的玩家。
《天机行：古朝之影》目前计划在 2027 年发售，登陆 PC（Steam）、Switch、Switch 2 以及 PS5 平台。对于一款题材比较小众，而且距离发售还有挺长时间的游戏来说，这个平台覆盖面可以说是相当广了。
虽然目前还言之过早，但在见到其水墨风的景色、脑海中有一个神秘声音的失忆主角的设定，以及需要玩家动脑的战斗系统之后，我对《天机行：古朝之影》持有谨慎乐观的态度。
本文编译自 IGN US 相关内容，原作者 Patrick Kolan，编译 Tony，未经授权禁止转载。

失忆男主闯荡手绘 HD-2D 风回合制 RPG

游戏基本信息：天机行：古朝之影 / Tianji: Shadow of the Ancients / 2027 年 / Nintendo Switch、Nintendo Switch 2、PS5、PC

Square Enix 用近年来的成果证明了 HD-2D 风格有着可观的受众规模，而这种风格也为复古回合制 RPG 注入了新鲜的血液。不过搭上了 HD-2D 这班车的可不光是 JRPG。来自中国台北的开发商杰仕登最近公布了他们倾心打造的 RPG 新作《天机行：古朝之影》。该作同样是一款向经典 RPG 致敬的类 HD-2D 作品，只不过带有浓郁而鲜明的中华风。

《天机行》的舞台并非使用魔法的奇幻世界，而是一个与现实世界相似却又不同、以“气”为能量的唐代。了解东方武侠的玩家肯定对“气”这个概念不陌生，但简而言之，“气”是存在于所有生灵中的能量，难点在于如何驾驭这股能量，从而用它施展出强大而神秘的力量。所以说起来，“气”其实也算是一种魔法，只不过有着不同的根源。

《天机行》的主角名唤上官朔，在剧情一开头，他被可疑组织“玄心教”弄得失去了记忆 —— 这可以说是主角的经典开局了。说真的，这些家伙就应该把头盔焊在头上。总而言之，以这次头部受伤为契机，他踏上了一段寻回记忆的旅途，在此过程中，他还需要搞清楚脑海里那个让他不断怀疑自我身份的神秘声音究竟是什么来头。

在旅途中，我们还会遇到一群乐于加入队伍，愿意在一个又一个回合里为主角挡刀的伙伴们。他们还真是古道热肠。

《天机行：古朝之影》将轻度探索与更具深度的回合制战斗机制结合在一起，带来了不错的效果。与 Square Enix 的像素点阵角色不同，《天机行》采用了清晰的 2D Q 版小人，更加贴近他们的正比例立绘形象。

这些 Q 版小人有不少动作细节，在引擎内即时渲染的过场动画里可以呈现出丰富的神态。而其余过场动画，则是采用了水墨画风格与传统 3D 场景相结合的形式。

《天机行》以虚幻引擎 5 打造，整个世界由 3D 的小村庄、城镇、洞窟、森林、山脉组成。镜头始终以固定距离跟随主角，带来了很好的景深效果。

整个游戏的设计配方可能会让你感到熟悉，但开头几小时的内容很容易让人投入其中 —— 即便你平时不喜欢玩回合制 RPG，觉得它们太慢太枯燥。就我个人而言，回合制 RPG 那种有条不紊、步步为营的节奏正是其魅力所在，不过喜好这种事情嘛，各花入各眼。

但为了照顾习惯了快节奏的“多动症”玩家，开发团队也很明智地加入了一些用于提速的现代化功能。比如战斗可以开 2 倍速；在等级达到一定程度后，遇到低等级敌人时可以直接将其秒杀，无需进战。

养成系统也秉承类似的理念：垂直技能树上有着相当丰富的分支，每一次加点都需要仔细斟酌，而不是形式主义、徒增臃肿的加点。技能会在整个队伍内形成联动效果，而不是只影响当前行动的角色。

大部分技能围绕属性克制设计，为战斗增添了一层策略性，避免了无脑按键的枯燥感。例如 Demo 中有一个名叫“乱星飞羽 贰”的技能，它会对随机目标发动三次攻击，若触发暴击，技能还会再生效一次。这足以让人预感到，在流程到了十多个小时后，技能树应该会展现出相当可观的深度。

在旅途中，玩家会结识到新的同伴，每个新队友都有专属的个人支线，以及一个其他人不能解锁的专属技能。多花些时间和一个角色相处，其专属技能就会得到强化，带来武器强化、营地烹饪 Buff、将闲置物品换成实用道具等等效果。

虽然“队友越用越强”是个老套路，但属于百试不爽的经典设计，给玩家提供了使用那些“二线”角色的理由，而不是全程只用最强的那三个角色。

在战斗的间隙，大地图上的那些“气脉”（Qi leylines）并非没有实际作用的趣味性背景设定。它们贯穿整个大地图，合理推测，后续它们应该会解释为什么《天机行》那么注重游戏中的景色。若是离开主干道四处探索，你会发现隐藏 Boss、支线任务和隐藏迷宫 —— 任何一款像样的 RPG，都会用这些要素来奖励那些喜欢无视任务标记、到处自由探索的玩家。

《天机行：古朝之影》目前计划在 2027 年发售，登陆 PC（Steam）、Switch、Switch 2 以及 PS5 平台。对于一款题材比较小众，而且距离发售还有挺长时间的游戏来说，这个平台覆盖面可以说是相当广了。

虽然目前还言之过早，但在见到其水墨风的景色、脑海中有一个神秘声音的失忆主角的设定，以及需要玩家动脑的战斗系统之后，我对《天机行：古朝之影》持有谨慎乐观的态度。

title: 《GUNDAM 异轨征途》试玩：全新次元的动作爽快感｜IGN 中国
author: Kamui Ye
text:
被新作的扎实手感吓了一跳
游戏基本信息：GUNDAM 异轨征途/GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT/2027 年 3 月 5 日/PC、PS5、Xbox Series X|S
根据目前已知的情报，计划在 2027 年 3 月 5 日上市的“机动战士高达”主题动作冒险新作《GUNDAM 异轨征途》将与明年 4 月首播的新番动画《机动战士高达RG XARX-ZERO》采用相同世界观，二者同属“RG Project”，只不过从时间线上来看，后上线的动画剧集反而是游戏的前传，讲述A.A.（After Apocalypse／天启后）45 年，“天启”硅基生态爆发、人类放弃地球、少年阿兹米·雷驾驶高达 ZERO 的起源故事。
而游戏里的剧情背景则已经来到动画部分的大约 100 年以后，玩家将扮演男主角雷克斯驾驶螺旋高达与外太空神秘硅基生物“天启”继续战斗，这也是我们在游戏中看到的很多敌人造型与传统“高达”系列截然不同的主要原因。哈啰“惟”从系列吉祥物升级为正经的剧情角色，在故事层面相信也有一些惊喜带给玩家。
你跟我说这是“高达”？
具体到试玩 DEMO 方面，我们玩到的内容和此前不少外媒已经放出的试玩关卡基本一致，都是专门圈定范围的三台机体构件和三个任务，无法实际体验到机体零部件自定义组合等内容，这部分玩法由制作人现场进行了简单的展示。
DEMO 新加入的关卡“砂之星球”中玩家将对战蝎型BOSS“奇美拉” 能选择的机体分别是“突击剑”“蛇腹剑”和“剑枪”，三个任务则是“铁道桥的攻防战”“本能”以及全新追加的“砂之星球”，由于试玩时间比较充裕，我分别使用三种机体完成了这三个任务，虽然数值的部分应该是经过特殊调校的没什么太大参考价值，但动作设定还有战斗手感仍然给我留下了比较深刻的印象。
作为《机动战士高达VS》系列等以往作品的老玩家，很明显可以感觉到之前万代南梦宫在开发相关产品的时候，奉行的是“手感部分可以妥协，但机体动态一定要有‘高达味’”的宗旨，而“异轨征途”的逻辑则完全相反，机体造型、战斗动作设计、武器性能等等部分已经几乎看不到一丝一毫传统高达动画、游戏的影子，完全符合我心目中一款高品质科幻题材机甲战斗类游戏的表现力标准，辅以快节奏的高速对战体验，最终在武器特效、打击感、机体受击互动等方面的表现给我带来了极大的惊喜。
但坏处就是身为一名钟爱高达系列 IP 超过 30 年的老粉，如果不告诉我这是一款“高达”主题的游戏，我真的很难从中找到足够突出的 IP 特征，正如今年 6 月我在 SGF 发布会现场第一次看到“异轨征途”的首曝预告时，直到片尾 LOGO 出现，我和周围很多人才恍然大悟，这竟然是一部“高达”主题的游戏。
DEMO 供我们选择的三台“构件”更像是三台使用不同武器组合的机体，外观上有着十分显著的差异，进入游戏之后的战斗方式、技能特征也有很大不同，但操作层面的逻辑基本都是一致的，不会因为换了机体就得重新熟悉一套新的键位，而且整体而言操控细节并不复杂，组合键肯定难免，但在可以接受的范围内。
进入具体任务之后玩家将以第三人称背后视角控制机体，如果之前玩过 FromSoftware 的《装甲核心》系列，相信可以无缝上手本作。落地首先搞清楚目标和大致方位，再通过消耗喷射背包的能量从空中或地面接近敌人并锁定，最后依靠远程、近战武器将其消灭，并不断重复这个循环直至过关。
整体而言 DEMO 里这三部机体都比较依赖近战的攻击方式，并且没有传统意义上的防御、格挡动作，因此非常考验玩家分配喷射能量的细节处理能力，几乎所有敌方攻击都要靠喷射闪避来躲开，形成一种更鼓励进攻而不是龟缩的战斗氛围。
与之相对应的，机体本身也的确拥有比较丰富的攻击手段，除了□弱攻击、△强攻击、R2 射击等基础攻击以外，还可以按下 L1 与□△○的组合来释放机体的小技能。这些技能往往自带一定的位移和攻击前后摇时间，但威力比普攻大很多，究竟是用它们穿插到普攻连招之间来打伤害，还是用作关键时刻的保命，就全看玩家的策略了，使用不当也可能被敌人抓住后摇间隙，从而遭受巨大的打击。
L2 可以用来控制 DEMO 中自带的“AP-U（启示单元）”，虽然从定位上相当于副武器的性质，但其实在战斗过程中的效用还是很明显的。AP-U有两种能力和主动、被动两种形态，其一是像浮游炮一样自动飞向附近敌人自主发动攻击，单个浮游炮单次攻击的威力并不大，但积少成多也能造成不俗的伤害；其二是主动释放之后能够在主角机面前结成一个类似能量护盾的装置，敌人的身体一旦碰到就会遭到反击并进入较大的硬直，是一种比较考验使用实机把控的能力。
最后则是类似于“大招”的 OVER-RISE 变身，位于喷射能量指示槽下方的能量槽攒满之后，玩家就可以按下 R3+L3 让机体进入 OVER-RISE 状态，此时机体的攻击方式虽然边变化不大，但攻击力会得到较大提升，机体本身也会产生一些外形上的改变，并喷射出红色的能量光芒。
在 OVER-RISE 状态下再按一次 R3+L3 则会使出机体威力最强的技能 AP-UNIT BURST，此时浮游炮会环绕目标放出红色的持续光线攻击，在制造大量伤害的同时禁锢敌人的行动，显然是全力输出的好时机。
AP-UNIT BURST 发动 最后再结合主角机体的“完美闪避”动作以及敌方 BOSS 血条下方的类似伤害槽（攒满之后会短暂倒地）这两个系统，基本就是“异轨征途”DEMO 版的全部战斗细节了。实际玩起来给人的感受首先是上手比较简单，很容易控制机体打出华丽的攻击动作，进而触发各种攻击特效，营造出沉浸感很强的战斗氛围，其次游戏的“卡肉停顿”，受击反馈，音效配合都做到了出类拔萃，3 种机体各自的近战武器虽然攻击范围、节奏差异明显，但都保持了良好的操作手感，真正凸显了战斗爽快感这个作品主题，让人十分享受战斗的过程。
此前官方已经公布了三套皮肤 结束试完之后，开发者在大屏幕上为我们演示了机体的自定义系统，也就是身体、武器各个零部件的替换功能，允许玩家按照自己的喜好打造独一无二的机体；另外游戏中还内置一个类似官方 MOD 的外观皮肤功能，现场展示了将主角机“螺旋高达”换成元祖高达皮肤的样子，虽然攻击方式还是保持不变，但外观、音效等等全都换成 RX-78-2 高达的形态，有一种莫名的违和感，此前官方也已经公布了“自由高达”“巴巴托斯高达”和“飞翼高达零式”三种皮肤，相信正式版里肯定还会有更多。
总结
就第一印象来说，《GUNDAM 异轨征途》显然相对于传统高达游戏的动作体系实现了颠覆式的创新，三台机体的外观设计本身就脱离了常规套路，武器、技能、动作表现更是令人眼前一亮，能难得的是在相对简单的操作体系下实现了招式表现的显著区分，每一台机器打起来的感觉都不太一样，这还是在没有体验任何自定义零部件系统的情况下。
再结合全新的“RG Project”世界观以及明年的新番动画，让我对这部作品剧情、人物方面的表现也产生了巨大的期待，从各个角度来讲本作都是广大机甲动作类游戏，当然还有“高达”IP 爱好者不容错过的一款具备突破属性的全新作品。

进入具体任务之后玩家将以第三人称背后视角控制机体，如果之前玩过 FromSoftware 的《装甲核心》系列，相信可以无缝上手本作。落地首先搞清楚目标和大致方位，再通过消耗喷射背包的能量从空中或地面接近敌人并锁定，最后依靠远程、近战武器将其消灭，并不断重复这个循环直至过关。

整体而言 DEMO 里这三部机体都比较依赖近战的攻击方式，并且没有传统意义上的防御、格挡动作，因此非常考验玩家分配喷射能量的细节处理能力，几乎所有敌方攻击都要靠喷射闪避来躲开，形成一种更鼓励进攻而不是龟缩的战斗氛围。

与之相对应的，机体本身也的确拥有比较丰富的攻击手段，除了□弱攻击、△强攻击、R2 射击等基础攻击以外，还可以按下 L1 与□△○的组合来释放机体的小技能。这些技能往往自带一定的位移和攻击前后摇时间，但威力比普攻大很多，究竟是用它们穿插到普攻连招之间来打伤害，还是用作关键时刻的保命，就全看玩家的策略了，使用不当也可能被敌人抓住后摇间隙，从而遭受巨大的打击。

L2 可以用来控制 DEMO 中自带的“AP-U（启示单元）”，虽然从定位上相当于副武器的性质，但其实在战斗过程中的效用还是很明显的。AP-U有两种能力和主动、被动两种形态，其一是像浮游炮一样自动飞向附近敌人自主发动攻击，单个浮游炮单次攻击的威力并不大，但积少成多也能造成不俗的伤害；其二是主动释放之后能够在主角机面前结成一个类似能量护盾的装置，敌人的身体一旦碰到就会遭到反击并进入较大的硬直，是一种比较考验使用实机把控的能力。

最后则是类似于“大招”的 OVER-RISE 变身，位于喷射能量指示槽下方的能量槽攒满之后，玩家就可以按下 R3+L3 让机体进入 OVER-RISE 状态，此时机体的攻击方式虽然边变化不大，但攻击力会得到较大提升，机体本身也会产生一些外形上的改变，并喷射出红色的能量光芒。

在 OVER-RISE 状态下再按一次 R3+L3 则会使出机体威力最强的技能 AP-UNIT BURST，此时浮游炮会环绕目标放出红色的持续光线攻击，在制造大量伤害的同时禁锢敌人的行动，显然是全力输出的好时机。

最后再结合主角机体的“完美闪避”动作以及敌方 BOSS 血条下方的类似伤害槽（攒满之后会短暂倒地）这两个系统，基本就是“异轨征途”DEMO 版的全部战斗细节了。实际玩起来给人的感受首先是上手比较简单，很容易控制机体打出华丽的攻击动作，进而触发各种攻击特效，营造出沉浸感很强的战斗氛围，其次游戏的“卡肉停顿”，受击反馈，音效配合都做到了出类拔萃，3 种机体各自的近战武器虽然攻击范围、节奏差异明显，但都保持了良好的操作手感，真正凸显了战斗爽快感这个作品主题，让人十分享受战斗的过程。

结束试完之后，开发者在大屏幕上为我们演示了机体的自定义系统，也就是身体、武器各个零部件的替换功能，允许玩家按照自己的喜好打造独一无二的机体；另外游戏中还内置一个类似官方 MOD 的外观皮肤功能，现场展示了将主角机“螺旋高达”换成元祖高达皮肤的样子，虽然攻击方式还是保持不变，但外观、音效等等全都换成 RX-78-2 高达的形态，有一种莫名的违和感，此前官方也已经公布了“自由高达”“巴巴托斯高达”和“飞翼高达零式”三种皮肤，相信正式版里肯定还会有更多。

总结

就第一印象来说，《GUNDAM 异轨征途》显然相对于传统高达游戏的动作体系实现了颠覆式的创新，三台机体的外观设计本身就脱离了常规套路，武器、技能、动作表现更是令人眼前一亮，能难得的是在相对简单的操作体系下实现了招式表现的显著区分，每一台机器打起来的感觉都不太一样，这还是在没有体验任何自定义零部件系统的情况下。

再结合全新的“RG Project”世界观以及明年的新番动画，让我对这部作品剧情、人物方面的表现也产生了巨大的期待，从各个角度来讲本作都是广大机甲动作类游戏，当然还有“高达”IP 爱好者不容错过的一款具备突破属性的全新作品。

title: 本周 Steam 值得关注的游戏 10.05 - 10.11（中）
author: 游戏发现
text:
上一部分
注： 本系列文章的信息主要整合自 Steam 与 SteamDB 的即将发售列表，由于 Steam 支持手动输入日期及发售、同步不及时等原因，本列表可能会遗漏收录一些作品的发售信息。如果本周有您的作品或您喜欢的作品未被列出，欢迎直接评论补充链接～～
Witch Cabin Cleanup
关键字： 整理、模拟、解谜
发行日期： 2026/10/08（暂无中文）
《Witch's Cabin Cleanup》是一款温馨的整理模拟游戏，让你在杂乱的女巫小屋里分类整理 5,313 件奇珍异物。在宁静而富有氛围感的环境中打扫、习得咒语、恢复秩序。
女仆咖啡厅模拟器（Maid Cafe Simulator）
关键字： 商店管理、模拟、视觉小说
发行日期： 2026/10/08（ 中文支持 ）
和五位兽人女仆一起，把破旧小店经营成人气女仆咖啡厅！接单、调制饮品、送单结账，还要亲自赶走闹事客人。在这款第一人称经营模拟游戏中，与女仆们日渐亲近，了解她们藏在笑容背后的故事，一起向美仆林三星进发！
Gear.Club Unlimited 3
关键字： 竞速、汽车模拟
发行日期： 2026/10/08（ 中文支持 ）
《Gear.Club》系列荣耀回归！自定义并调校您最爱的赛车，极速驰骋在法国地中海海岸与日本的公路上。不仅要赢，更要展现风格！
勇敢者之试炼（Invokyr）
关键字： 在线合作、生存恐怖、棋盘游戏、冒险
发行日期： 2026/10/08（ 中文支持 ）EA
一款以诅咒桌游为主题的多人合作生存恐怖游戏。一盒尘封的棋盘，一栋闹鬼的老宅。支持最多 6 人联机。掷出骰子，在接踵而至的恐怖中拼死求生，击败游戏主宰，赢回你的自由。
Dancing with Ghosts
关键字： 剧情丰富、冒险
发行日期： 2026/10/08（暂无中文）EA
《Dancing with Ghosts》是一款鼓舞人心的叙事类游戏，讲述了在经历失去后重新学会生活的故事。在充满活力的泰国河畔村庄里，与一位开朗的幽灵成为朋友，通过跳舞、制作罗蒂饼以及帮助邻居，积累善缘以帮助她恢复记忆，并在每一次人际互动中获得治愈。
大钻头矿业无限公司（Drillbound）
关键字： 增量、采矿
发行日期： 2026/10/08（ 中文支持 ）
《大钻头矿业无限公司》是一款精致的短篇增量游戏，您将在这开启一场直达星球地心的挖掘之旅。带上您的大钻头，粉碎岩层，躲避飞溅而出的岩块，收集资源，升级钻头！并在不断向地心深处挺进的过程中解锁强大的尖端科技。
Forever Ago
关键字： 冒险、探索、剧情丰富
发行日期： 2026/10/08（ 中文支持 ）
在这款单人公路旅行冒险游戏中，遭逢悲惨变故的阿尔弗雷德踏上了北上之路。
MIU
关键字： 视觉小说、多结局
发行日期： 2026/10/08（ 中文支持 ）
《MIU》是一部黑白手绘风格的视觉小说。一次没有目的地的散步，你遇见了一个忘记自己名字的少女。因为她有件很重要的事必须想起来，于是就跟在了你的身后。和她一起走过商店街、在咖啡店坐坐、寻找一只猫，再留下一张今天的照片。途中，你会遇见几位奇怪的人，也慢慢发现她藏在闲聊与沉默里的心事。 游戏包含多条剧情分支与共 26 个结局。 你的选择或许会影响故事的发展，而某些角色与剧情，也可能需要一点点特别的方式让他们登场。
Thunder Hoop Collection (QUByte Classics)
关键字： 动作、街机、复古
发行日期： 2026/10/08（ 中文支持 ）
在这款终极版《雷霆环》合集中，奔跑、射击，摧毁成群的变异生物。在两款爆裂感十足的复古平台游戏中，迎战根布雷克教授的生物怪兽，体验地道的 90 年代街机风采！
Dino Time Raiders
关键字： 恐龙、策略、挂机游戏
发行日期： 2026/10/08（暂无中文）
穿越时空，捕捉恐龙并将其变成利润。指挥混乱的任务，抓捕史前生物，打造终极恐龙乐园。管理研究、升级与灾难，一切都为了科学与自由市场。
Wildaria
关键字： 生物收集、冒险、开放世界、角色扮演
发行日期： 2026/10/09（暂无中文）EA
驯服任何生物。骑着它们驰骋战场。向动物之神发起挑战。探索一个无限广阔、程序生成的奇幻世界，在这里，每一种生物都能成为你的伙伴。在这款开放世界动作冒险 RPG 中，与伙伴们并肩战斗、完成任务、进行交易，并共同成长变强。
Echo Weaver
关键字： 解谜、类银河战士恶魔城、时空操控
发行日期： 2026/10/09（ 中文支持 ）
时间是你最宝贵的资源，唯有秘密能让你成长升级。畅玩这款知识型类银河战士恶魔城游戏，掌握正在崩解的时间循环。扮演最后一名织者，利用扭曲时间的异常，以所知所学打破循环。探索残存的一切，揭开谜团，完美驾驭循环。
Silver Pines
关键字： 生存恐怖、类银河战士恶魔城、库存管理
发行日期： 2026/10/09（ 中文支持 ）
《银松镇》是一款生存、恐怖、类银河战士恶魔城游戏，背景设定在美国小镇。在噩梦般的恐怖中奋战，破解重重谜题，同时管理稀缺资源，逐步揭开那些可能掌握救赎之钥的谜团。
Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival
关键字： 鲜血、动作、恐怖、色情内容
发行日期： 2026/10/09（ 中文支持 ）
置身传奇惊悚系列，体验前所未有的全新篇章。《克里夫·巴克猛鬼追魂：复苏》将第一人称动作恐怖生存游戏提升到了全新高度。
Dragon Dinner
关键字： 时间管理、模拟、类 Rogue、龙
发行日期： 2026/10/09（ 中文支持 ）
集高强度策略经营、看似可爱实则难缠的龙于一身的爆爽体验！应对混乱不断的顾客潮，巧妙规划餐厅布局，在用餐高峰时期，招待一波又一波饥肠辘辘的龙。
Tower Tactics II
关键字： 塔防、牌组构建式类 Rogue
发行日期： 2026/10/09（暂无中文）EA
融合卡组构筑 Roguelike 与塔防玩法的体验强势回归，而且规模前所未有！用全新强力卡牌打造你的牌组，解锁独特饰品（Trinkets），部署强化后的防御塔，迎战一波接一波的敌人进攻与全新的策略挑战。
幻想放置远征队（Duelist: Idle Expedition）
关键字： 挂机游戏、日系角色扮演、冒险
发行日期： 2026/10/09（ 中文支持 ）
运行在屏幕底部的 JRPG 风格放置自动战斗养成游戏。在《幻想放置远征队》中组建你的精锐部队，从 90+ 种 JRPG 像素风职业中招募成员，带领你的旅团击败决斗者大陆上的所有队伍，成为最强旅团！即使你正忙于工作，这段史诗旅程也永不停歇！ （摸鱼时的完美搭档！）
Keep Watering
关键字： 增量、挂机游戏、农业
发行日期： 2026/10/09（ 中文支持 ）
《Keep Watering》是一款具有舒适而催眠循环体验的增量游戏，每一滴水都会成长为非凡的事物。
Birdseed
关键字： 免费开玩、VR、在线合作、鸟
发行日期： 2026/10/09（暂无中文）
在虚拟现实中为那些体型最圆滚滚、最可爱的鸟儿拍照吧！在郁郁葱葱的森林中放松身心，完成别出心裁的每日任务，并写日记。无论你是独自观鸟还是与朋友结伴，都能舒舒服服地沉浸在大自然中。
放置像素女仆（Idle Pixel Maids）
关键字： AI 生成内容、挂机游戏
发行日期： 2026/10/09（ 中文支持 ）
与 14 位美少女女仆共度悠闲时光的像素咖啡馆放置游戏！用 280 种家具布置咖啡馆，摸摸来访的猫咪，通过 MoChat 自由聊天。把女仆拖出游戏窗口，她还会在桌面上为你跳舞。AI 对话在你的电脑上本地运行，无需联网，也无需额外订阅。
下一部分
最后一部分周四送上，敬请期待！

title: Dungeons & Dragons: World of Warcraft is already a slam dunk, but it's how it captures the spirit of the MMO that makes it stand out
author: Tyler Colp
text:
Despite the immense volume of similarities between Dungeons & Dragons and World of Warcraft, the team working on the upcoming collab rulebook knows that you can't translate everything 1:1. Half of the MMO is about fighting the same bosses over and over until you finally get a good piece of loot. The grind isn't made for tabletop players.
During a recent presentation attended by PC Gamer, principal game designer and project lead James Wyatt says D&D: WoW is more about "paraphrasing" the MMO within the framework of the tabletop game rather than trying to emulate its mechanics. The entire world of Azeroth and the MMO's many expansions (up to Midnight) are fair game for players—the book opens with a big temporal hand-wave from time dragon Chromie—but the smallest details have been shuffled around to fit the format.
Popular dungeons from WoW's past, like the Deadmines, are mostly intact, save for a few alternate routes to accommodate parties who might want to sneak around bosses or skip some altogether. You're still in for the kinds of adventures through deep caverns and ancient cities that WoW players reminisce about today. Some dungeons are lifted right from WoW's earliest era, while others mix in their revised layouts (and loot) from later expansions.
(Image credit: Wizards of the Coast) I was delighted to hear that you can still take on the challenge of avoiding every boss in Dire Maul for the bonus rewards after you slay the king, otherwise known as a "tribute run" to WoW veterans. D&D: WoW is built to capture the spirit of exploring the MMO's dungeons for the first time, before the age of datamined loot tables and YouTube guides, while also letting you relive their most iconic moments at the table.
The team calls dungeons a toolbox for DMs to tell the stories of WoW's world without the trial-and-error of the MMO's combat or the tension of deciding who the blue dagger drop should go to. Enemy encounters are curated and there are no restrictions on taking a rest or leaving and coming back later—although the dangers can grow while you're away.
Wizards of the Coast Wizards of the Coast Wizards of the Coast Wizards of the Coast Climactic battles with WoW's biggest names are in there, too, including the Lich King, Illidan, Jaina Proudmoore, and more. They're also where you'll see some of the biggest changes from the MMO. Jaina, for example, doesn't gradually chill your party during the fight, but freezes a player and strikes them with an ice lance if you don't find a way to thaw them out fast enough (the devs recommend using fire, if you've got it) instead.
On the way to the dungeons, you'll have opportunities to prepare your party through WoW's gathering and crafting professions. D&D's crafting rules didn't require a ton of changes to make this work, the team says. You'll be able to do a wisdom check for supplies or ore to mine as you explore. You can take that ore and craft items from a list of recipes, provided you're proficient with the right tools. Powerful items, like armor, will be gated by your proficiency bonus, so there's a real incentive to keep improving your skills as you go along.
D&D's renown system also isn't that far off from WoW's faction reputation system, so the team kept it fairly straightforward: You earn rewards as you climb up the ranks of trust. Becoming exalted with the Earthen Ring can unlock a charm that lets you summon a big Elemental minion or a portal to teleport across the world. The dragon aspects, WoW's oldest and most powerful factions, will even grant you the equivalent of a Wish spell if they like you enough. Rival factions, where raising your reputation with one might damage the other, can show up, too.
(Image credit: Wizards of the Coast) Everything here sounds like a smart way to handle a collab that could've barely felt like a collab at all. WoW has so much overlap with D&D already that I can imagine a version of this book that just swaps some names around and calls it a day. Instead, you can tell this was created by people who know exactly what to pull out of Blizzard's world and what to leave behind.
We were told a lot more will be revealed in the lead up to the November 12 release, particularly the way classes from WoW map onto the tabletop format. Wyatt—who spent most of the presentation eagerly answering questions from chat—had to stop himself from spoiling things too early. He also says he's already thinking of all the leftover things that could fit into a follow-up book, but wants to see how this one goes before diving back into Azeroth.

title: Arc Raiders is looking for 'more ways to integrate real human performances' starting with Celeste's visual overhaul for Frozen Trail
author: Elie Gould
text:
Embark is doing some monumental spring cleaning in the lead up to its major Arc Raiders ' update Frozen Trail . There's been an overhaul to its anticheat approach , the news of a potential PvE test , and a change to loot hotspots . But amid all of this, we're also getting a rework to one of Speranza's most important residents: Celeste.
Diana Gardner has been the voice of Celeste, Speranza's de facto leader, since the beginning, but Stefan Strandberg, the chief creative officer at Embark, explained in a blog post how Celeste has "never fully represented the depth of Diana’s performance." As her "limited expressive capabilities" held the character back and broke immersion for players, failing to communicate "the stakes and stories we want to tell."
(Image credit: Embark) "Sometimes high fidelity, dynamic facial expressions are important to anchor the gravity of the story, and this is something that has constrained us up to this point," Strandberg adds.
So, with this in mind, Embark has set about reworking Celeste, with Gardner becoming her new face. "This is the first time we have used full motion capture, including a more detailed and accurate face, that allows us to map expressions and emotion in more detail. This means that more of Diana’s performance and identity comes through the screen."
This does mean Celeste will look different on October 6 when Frozen Trail releases, but rest assured all "you’re watching is the authentic performance of an incredibly talented actor, the real Celeste on screen for the first time."
(Image credit: Embark Studios) It won't just end here though, as this is the start of a new wave of visual reworks for Arc Raiders as the team also intends to take a look at other characters. "In future updates, we plan to bring more characters in line with their real-world actors," Strandberg explains. "Not only will this mean more faithful representations of actors, it’ll be felt by players themselves."
Arc Raiders has always had one of the most exceptional worlds to explore, but it has unfortunately fallen short when it comes to characters. They are by and large just quite dull , sure the designs kind of look cool, but they've have always just been quest giving machines rather than convincing citizens of a game. This is not helped by its use of AI when it comes to beefing up voicelines .
So it comes as no surprise that Embark is seeking to remedy this, by "finding more ways to integrate real human performances into every interaction". Because that is the only way to tell a successful and convincing story.

title: RuneScape dev apologises after RuneFest debut of an AI-generated six-fingered character: 'That's pretty hard to explain away'
author: Mollie Taylor
text:
RuneScape developer Jagex descended upon Birmingham (the British one, not the Alabama one) over the weekend with its annual RuneFest. As part of its RuneScape keynote, it showed off a trailer for its upcoming Dragon Slayer 2 quest which, er, featured a player character with six fingers and a bizarre sneaker-like sole on their very not- sneaker armoured shoes.
It didn't take long for posts on social media to point out what was undeniably generative AI, and an incident which, unfortunately for Jagex, came very swiftly after another genAI controversy surrounding its clothing collaboration with 100 Thieves just days before.
Despite the trailer being for RS3, Old School RuneScape's Alec 'Mod Sween' Sween took the lead on releasing a statement on the 2007scape subreddit addressing the situation. "We're aware of the concerns raised about the Dragon Slayer 2 trailer and have taken it down, while we investigate this urgently," he wrote. "This trailer was produced by a trusted external partner who had explicitly confirmed that GenAI would not be used. But, among other things, there's a sixth finger and, well, that's pretty hard to explain away. For that we apologise."
(Image credit: Jagex) Similar to his statement after the 100 Thieves incident, Sween reiterated Jagex's stance. "Our position is clear at Jagex: we don't use GenAI to create our games, artwork or creative assets, and will not knowingly allow it to be used on our behalf. This is the second time in quick succession that concerns about generative AI have arisen through partners we trusted, and for us that highlights an issue with our own processes which we must address."
Sween said that the developer is "overhauling" the review process, and in the meantime will "work with and commission creators from the community to make sure that the story of Dragon Slayer 2 is told to the standard befitting of such an update."
I can't help but feel a little surprised that a video this blatantly riddled with generative AI slipped through the cracks—the six fingers are clear as day, even if you manage to miss everything else—and in a response Sween said that the team "should have caught these things," adding: "We didn't do well enough and can't simply place the blame elsewhere."
For Jagex's sake, I hope the phrase "bad things come in threes" does not also apply to generative AI videogame controversies.

title: Developer gets a little too silly, recommends deadly psychoactive ingredient in its bad boy-themed cocktail
author: Mollie Taylor
text:
Fun, thematic videogame recipes are not new. Suggesting dangerous and potentially lethal ingredients, however? Well, Love and Deepspace might just be the first game to make such a bold move.
Yes, Infold's hunky dating gacha recently posted to X with a handful of fun cocktails themed around the male suitors you can romance. Something worth noting here is that each one has a signature flower associated with them—childhood friend Caleb is the crabapple blossom, Xavier has the forget-me-not, and doctor Zayne is the jasmine. These are not the flowers that are the issue.
Shake, swirl... and take a sip! One taste of this Special Blend🍸️ and you won't forget it.Exotic Fruits picked together are blended into a taste of happiness.A little of this, a little of that, and one last must-have ingredient...?🍸️What secret ingredient would you add to this Special Blend made just for him?🎁Feel free to post with the hashtag #SleeplessBanquet or share in the comments. You can share text, screenshots, or photos!We will randomly select 5 Hunters to receive a redeem code for [Diamond*100, Stamina*100, and Gold*10,000]!———🪐Official Discord: https://t.co/hKmnBAbbgu🪐Download and Log in Now: https://t.co/bNEP8yM6bZ#LoveandDeepspace #ANightThatNeverEnds September 29, 2026
The problematic posies in question come from the game's other two romantic interests, Rafayel and Sylus—whose signature flowers are the fire lily and datura respectively. They are, erm, quite toxic. And potentially even deadly. In the datura's case, it's also a psychoactive plant. Which makes it even more surprising that Infold deigned to include them as garnishes in these fun and funky cocktail recipes.
It took the developer a whopping 36 hours to post a follow-up tweet which read: "Safety notice: All drinks shown are fictional and for in-game purposes only. Do not attempt to recreate or consume them in reality." Of course, by this point, the original post had already been community noted and flooded with fans asking the very important question: "Hey, what the hell?"
I'm not sure I've ever seen a developer create thematic food and drink recipes with real ingredients that weren't meant to be recreated, which makes this whole situation even more bizarre. You can certainly create interesting cocktails for your characters that don't rely on a potentially deadly flower, and providing recipes people aren't even meant to follow begs the question of why Infold would even bother in the first place?
Let's just hope nobody ever lets Infold create one of those fandangled videogame cookbooks.
html:
Fun, thematic videogame recipes are not new. Suggesting dangerous and potentially lethal ingredients, however? Well, Love and Deepspace might just be the first game to make such a bold move.

Yes, Infold's hunky dating gacha recently posted to X with a handful of fun cocktails themed around the male suitors you can romance. Something worth noting here is that each one has a signature flower associated with them—childhood friend Caleb is the crabapple blossom, Xavier has the forget-me-not, and doctor Zayne is the jasmine. These are not the flowers that are the issue.

The problematic posies in question come from the game's other two romantic interests, Rafayel and Sylus—whose signature flowers are the fire lily and datura respectively. They are, erm, quite toxic. And potentially even deadly. In the datura's case, it's also a psychoactive plant. Which makes it even more surprising that Infold deigned to include them as garnishes in these fun and funky cocktail recipes.

It took the developer a whopping 36 hours to post a follow-up tweet which read: "Safety notice: All drinks shown are fictional and for in-game purposes only. Do not attempt to recreate or consume them in reality." Of course, by this point, the original post had already been community noted and flooded with fans asking the very important question: "Hey, what the hell?"

I'm not sure I've ever seen a developer create thematic food and drink recipes with real ingredients that weren't meant to be recreated, which makes this whole situation even more bizarre. You can certainly create interesting cocktails for your characters that don't rely on a potentially deadly flower, and providing recipes people aren't even meant to follow begs the question of why Infold would even bother in the first place?

Let's just hope nobody ever lets Infold create one of those fandangled videogame cookbooks.

title: I am cavorting with a gazelle's grace in Grand Theft Auto 5
author: Joshua Wolens
text:
Los Santos Customs
I'm modding GTA 5 every day in a quest to either transform it into a PC version of GTA 6 or break it entirely. Come back tomorrow to find out what new horrible thing I've done to Rockstar's baby, or check out what I got up to earlier .
La Rochefoucauld once wrote, "What grace is to the body, good sense is to the mind." He wrote this some time before the release of Grand Theft Auto 5 , and was likely referring to Mirror's Edge instead.
Regardless, it holds true today. And you know what? Whatever their qualities, the gentlemen of GTA 5 simply don't have much grace to them. They are lumpy, ambling figures, and move like young children unused to their bulk. I have rectified this using Back Flip Mod —a mod for back flip. "Simple backflip for Single Player," it says, with an alarmingly cavalier attitude to capitalisation and style-guide coherence.
But it's true. Now, with a tap of page down (enormous shoutout to the author for choosing page down, by the way: one of few keys left on my keyboard not already colonised by another mod) the lads of Los Santos will, whimsically, backflip in place. Then they'll get very pleased with themselves for pulling it off.
(Image credit: Rockstar) "There's a chance the backflip fails and your character ragdolls," notes the mod's author, which is delicious. Of course, in my testing so far, failures happen not mid-backflip but more at the conception of the backflip idea.
That is to say, you hit the backflip button and—if the dice roll deems it to be a failure—your character collapses immediately, without even moving. In fairness, many of my own ideas and impulses fail in precisely the same way.

title: Despite calling Grand Theft Auto 'a videogame franchise built around criminal activity,' Miami-Dade sheriff isn't mad about the NBA's 'Vice City' transformation
author: Andy Chalk
text:
THEN:
NOW:
WHAT?
Vice City and Leonida, the fictional city and state that serve as the setting for Grand Theft Auto 6 , are largely based on Miami and the state of Florida, and Rockstar and publisher Take-Two Interactive are moving heavy and hard to leverage that real-life inspiration to promote GTA 6 as its console release gets closer.
The sheriff made no bones about her position on the matter when the proposed partnership came to light in September, however, characterizing the game as exactly the sort of thing Miami-Dade shouldn't associate with.
"Grand Theft Auto is a videogame franchise built around criminal activity," Cordero-Stutz said at the time. "Its fictional world includes murder, robbery, drug trafficking, carjacking, violence against law enforcement, and other conduct that the men and women of the Miami-Dade Sheriff’s Office work every single day to prevent."
It was a hard line in the sand, but it didn't add up to much. Despite some opposition from local positions, much of it predicated on similar law-and-order concerns, those PR campaigns have moved ahead. The City of Miami Beach voted in September to approve a 'discreet' campaign , for instance, while the Kaseya Center, a downtown arena in Miami that serves as home of the NBA's Miami Heat, took a rather less subtle approach, erecting a massive " Welcome to Vice City " sign on its roof that can be seen by travellers flying into Miami International Airport.
The Kaseya Center campaign became even more prominent in October when the Heat, one of the NBA's highest-profile teams, became directly involved via the Night in Vice City campaign, a one-night-only promotion that will see both the arena and the team rebranded in Vice City livery. It is, as former US President Joe Biden once said , "a big fuckin' deal."
A post shared by Miami HEAT (@miamiheat)
A photo posted by
(It also revealed that our UK team does not know ball , but that's a whole different kind of problem.)
I thought the sheriff might take issue with such a high-profile embrace of a videogame she had so wholeheartedly decried just a month ago, Despite her previously-expressed opposition, though, she seemingly has no issue with the Heat hopping on board.
"Sheriff Cordero-Stutz’s comments focused on the proposed use of publicly owned facilities and infrastructure, including public transportation, transit stations, and Miami International Airport, to promote Grand Theft Auto 6," a sheriff's department representative told PC Gamer. "Her concerns addressed the message conveyed through the use of these public assets. Those comments were not directed at promotional decisions by private businesses or organizations."
We're not giving away pistols and cocaine to people
Miami Beach Commissioner Monica Matteo-Salinas, arguing in favor of GTA 6 collab
I'm not sure how much of a difference the public/private thing makes in a practical sense—public or private, 'Miami is becoming Vice City' is the very high-profile crux of the campaign—but in spite of the many years passed since the Hot Coffee scandal , it's a needle that some are still trying to thread. The promo campaign approved by Miami Beach, for instance, will be managed by Boucher Brothers, a "hospitality management" company in Florida: Advertising materials will appear on things like Boucher Brothers chairs and umbrellas, rather than on city property.
Those chairs and umbrellas may appear on city property, which makes me think that trying to put some sort of minimum safe distance between them and the responsibilities of civic leadership might be largely moot.
On the other hand, the outright alarmism of days past has clearly receded. The glitzy rebranding of Miami and other parts of Florida speaks for itself, and Cordero-Stutz's admonishment notwithstanding, police don't seem too worried that pretending to be Vice City is going to turn Miami into actual Vice City: During the Miami Beach debates, for instance, one city commissioner said an officer he spoke to laughed off concerns about the impact of the game and promotional campaign on the city. Crass commercialism isn't really my bag but as someone who was around for the entire Jack Thompson era, I have to admit that this is kind of nice to see.
